decisions.reason: The net price display plugin has been absent from the website since 2019, which weakens confidence in it, but a small plugin close to the core offer still costs little to keep listed.
The ERP interface fits the firm's multichannel direction and keeps integration opportunities open, so keeping it is justified despite its lack of recent visibility.
Two years without website presence suggest weak demand, but one price tracking plugin is worth keeping as the consolidated variant while the redundant siblings are pruned.
D overlaps with C and E and has shown no visible results since 2019, so its value is unlikely to be realized and consolidation frees resources.
E is a redundant tracker variant with no evidence of traction over three years, which justifies abandoning the option.
The net price reporting plugin complements the firm's analytics offer and is cheap to maintain, so the option stays open despite limited visibility.
